name: cloud.blob
doc:
cloud.blob: one interface for object storage (docs/STDLIB.md level
3b), implemented over cloud.s3 (OpenS3) and over a local directory
(OpenDir), so code and tests can switch between a bucket and the file
system. Keys are "/"-separated; a missing key fails with
blob.ErrNotFound (errors.Is) in both implementations.

items.name: ErrNotFound
items.doc: ErrNotFound is returned for a missing object in any blob store.
items.summary: ErrNotFound is returned for a missing object in any blob store.

items.name: Open
items.doc:
Opens a bucket by URL: "file:///path/to/dir", or
"s3://bucket/prefix/?endpoint=http://localhost:9000&region=us-east-1&path_style=true"
(credentials from the environment or ~/.aws/credentials).
items.summary: Opens a bucket by URL: "file:///path/to/dir", or "s3://bucket/prefix/?endpoint=http://localhost:9000&region=us-east-1&path_style=true" (credentials from the environment or ~/.aws/credentials).

items.name: OpenDir
items.doc: A Bucket over dir (created if missing).
items.summary: A Bucket over dir (created if missing).

items.name: OpenS3
items.signature: func OpenS3(c *cloud.s3.Client, bucket string, prefix string) *S3Bucket
items.doc: OpenS3 returns a bucket over an S3 client; keys are relative to prefix.
items.summary: OpenS3 returns a bucket over an S3 client; keys are relative to prefix.

items.name: DirBucket
items.doc:
A Bucket over a directory: key "a/b.txt" is the file dir/a/b.txt.
Keys with "..", "." or empty segments, or a leading "/", are refused.
items.summary: A Bucket over a directory: key "a/b.txt" is the file dir/a/b.txt.
